item.title: visualstudio: Organize and revisit tabs with the keyboard
item.description:
Visual Studio adds keyboard shortcuts to reorder document tabs and navigate back to them by their visual position. The update focuses on tab organization and quick revisiting without using the mouse.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog
